entities.summary: Jamison Crowder is an American professional football wide receiver and return specialist. He played college football for the Duke Blue Devils and was selected by the Washington Redskins in the fourth round of the 2015 NFL draft. Crowder has also played for the New York Jets and Buffalo Bills.
